packageRules.description: Pinned for hubitat_ci:0.17 compatibility (Groovy 2.5.4 / Spock 1.2-groovy-2.5, which cap the usable JDK/Gradle range) - do not auto-upgrade.
hubitat_ci:0.17 and Spock 1.3-groovy-2.5 need Groovy 2.5; groovy-all 3.x breaks the Spock transform (compileTestGroovy fails).
Stay on the groovy-2.5 build of Spock to match groovy-all 2.5.x.
